name: Mashiki (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Mashiki town emblem in white: an outlined plum blossom of five rings enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mashiki, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 June 1989.

features.role: Mashiki town emblem — an outlined plum blossom of five rings enclosing a stylised character
